intro: Turkmenistan has around 7 million people, though official figures are uncertain.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are Turkmen, with Uzbek and Russian minorities. Turkmen is a Turkic language written in Latin letters. Most people are Sunni Muslim.
Tribal identity and traditional dress remain important.

chapters.title: Ashgabat
text: The capital, Ashgabat, holds a world record for the most white marble buildings.

keyTerms.meaning: The main ethnic group and language.
